description: This file contains session management functions for a UI, including subscribing, loading, patching, and deleting sessions, with external dependencies on API requests and error handling.

methods.name: subscribeSessions
methods.description: Subscribes to session updates via client request.

methods.name: loadSessions
methods.description: Loads session list with optional filters and handles errors.

methods.name: patchSession
methods.description: Updates a session's properties and reloads sessions.

methods.name: deleteSessionsAndRefresh
methods.description: Deletes specified sessions, handles errors, and refreshes session list.
